title: 第二章：黄金蛇
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏行枫在自家院子里来回试了很长一段时间，终于是知道了怎么回事，原来就是自己手上的戒子，戒子是爷爷留下的。正是他爷爷去世那年，他从部队请假回来，见到了爷爷最后一面，在爷爷最后一口气时说“孩子，这戒子是祖上一直留到现在的，虽说我也不知道有什么用，但是祖上留下的东西就要好好的保存着，你

因为正是那颗珠子的原因，戒子吸收了珠子里的能量戒子才得以再次开启。戒子传递了一小段信息，戒子原名叫“星空戒”，可随心意所想来回穿越两个世界之间，而戒子还有一方空间，长宽高各300米，除了活物以外，可在戒子10米范围之内收取任何物体。

而且戒子可以随主人修炼实力强弱和能量摄取提升戒子容量和功能。苏行枫在家收割完那条巨蛇，把肉全收进了戒子内，而戒子有一个很好的功能，那就是收进去的东西是处于时间静止状态，比什么保鲜冰箱都要好，通过这几天的晒制他也把蛇皮处理好。

他在这几天内熟悉了戒子的穿越功能，同时也发现另一个世界和这个世界有所不同，那就是在这世界过去一天而那个世界却过去了三天。戒子中的信息有提到过‘修炼’两字。

虽说现在他还搞不明白‘修炼’两字是什么意思，但是这几天内，他食用了蛇肉且大概有一个认识，那就是食用过蛇肉后自己的身体明显变强了许多。

今天他准备去趟市里准备购买一些装备，他想好好的去另一个世界探索了解一翻。查看了一下手机上的银行短信信息。从退伍到现在一直没有工作，一直是靠着在山上搞点山货拿出去出售，加上上回买了一大群鸡仔，现在卡上不足以购买到好的装备了。所以他想了想，就把处理好的蛇皮拿出去出售。

蛇皮处理好打好包，卷在一起足足有三十多公斤重，大小足有一个成年人那么大。他骑着自己那辆从村长手上收购来的二手摩托就下山了，从山里到市里的距离有七十多公里，摩托车要一个多小时才能到达。

“行枫哥，你这是要去哪啊？”

“安子啊！我这不是想去趟市里，看能不能在那把山货卖点高价嘛！”

“你就骑这辆我家那老头的摩托车去？就不怕半路给你撩个了？”

“怎么说话呢？你不不相信我的技术还是看不起你家老爷子的人品？当初我买它时你家老爷子可说过了，要是半路撩个了，他可是会来支援的啊！他要是不来，这不是还有你这个当儿子的吗？”

“我....算了，不和你说了，我也正好去市里，要不你坐我的车去吧？我还真怕你半路撩在那，到时麻烦的还是我。”

“那我就在这先谢谢你了，不过呢，我还是相信它的，你先走吧！我慢慢的骑过去就行”

“那好吧！你路上注意安全，别骑太快了”

说完就听一阵汽车蜂鸣声随着一路的灰尘远去。

和苏行枫说话的正是村长的儿子苏安，而苏行枫的二手的摩托车就是从他老子那买来的。苏安从小就仗着自己老子是村长，在村里大呼小叫的，可以说在村里年青一代算是个小霸王了。但是苏行枫除外，因为小时候苏安一直和苏行枫斗，可苏安就是斗不过，这一来二去苏安就认了。这不是苏行枫比他大一点嘛！所以就一直这么叫着行枫哥。

嘟嘟……

随着这辆二手摩托车的“嘟嘟”声，苏行枫也向着苏市前去。

骑了一个多小时他终于是到了市里，可是现在市区内禁摩，苏行枫只好把自己的摩托停在郊区锁好，然后乘坐公交车进入市区。

经过多次辗转他来到一个市场，这是市里最大的市场，什么东西都有出售，打听了一下哪有收蛇皮的地方。他背着一个大包就来到一个同仁堂药材门市店。

店面很大，这是搞批发的门市。

“先生，请问你是要采购什么药材？”这时一个小妹看到苏行枫进店就走上前问道。

Su Xingfeng tried it back and forth in his yard for a long time, and finally figured out what was going on. It turned out to be the ring on his hand, which was left by his grandfather.It was the year his grandfather passed away. He came back from the army on leave and saw his grandfather for the last time. When he took his last breath, he said, "My son, this ring was left by our ancestors until now. Although I don't know what its use is, the things left by our ancestors must be well preserved. You

Because it was because of that bead that the ring absorbed the energy in the bead and the ring was able to be opened again.The ring conveyed a short piece of information. The ring's original name was the "Starry Sky Ring". It could travel back and forth between the two worlds as desired. The ring also had a space with a length, width and height of 300 meters. Except for living objects, any object could be collected within 10 meters of the ring.

Moreover, the ring can increase the capacity and function of the ring according to the owner's cultivation strength and energy intake.Su Xingfeng finished harvesting the giant snake at home and put all the meat into the ring. The ring has a very good function, that is, the things put in are in a state of stillness in time, which is better than any fresh-keeping refrigerator. After several days of drying, he has also processed the snake skin.

In the past few days, he became familiar with the time-travel function of the ring, and at the same time, he also discovered that the other world was different from this world, that is, one day had passed in this world and three days had passed in that world.The message in the ring mentioned the word ‘cultivation’.

Although he still doesn't understand what the word 'cultivation' means, in the past few days, he has eaten snake meat and has an understanding that his body has become significantly stronger after eating snake meat.

Today he was going to the city to buy some equipment. He wanted to explore another world.I checked the bank text messages on my phone.I haven't had a job since I was discharged from the army. I have been relying on getting some mountain goods in the mountains to sell. In addition, I bought a lot of chickens last time, and now I don't have enough money to buy good equipment.So he thought about it and took out the processed snake skin for sale.

The snakeskin is processed and packed, and rolled together it weighs more than thirty kilograms and is as big as an adult.He rode his second-hand motorcycle purchased from the village chief down the mountain. The distance from the mountain to the city was more than 70 kilometers, and it took more than an hour for the motorcycle to arrive.

"Brother Xing Feng, where are you going?"

"Anzi!I don’t want to go to the market to see if I can sell some mountain goods at a higher price!"

"You're just going to ride this old man's motorcycle?Aren't you afraid that someone might flirt with you halfway?"

"How to speak?Don’t you distrust my skills or do you look down on your old man’s character?When I bought it, your old man told me that if I flirted with you halfway, he would come to support me!If he didn't come, wouldn't he still have you as his son?"

"I...forget it, I won't tell you anymore, I just happen to be going to the city, how about you take my car?I'm really afraid that if you tease me halfway, I will be the one in trouble."

"Then I'll thank you in advance, but I still believe it, you go first!I’ll just ride over slowly."

"Okay then!Please be safe on the road and don’t ride too fast.”

After saying that, I heard a car buzzing and disappeared along with the dust along the way.

The person talking to Su Xingfeng was Su An, the village chief's son, and Su Xingfeng bought his second-hand motorcycle from his father.Su An has been shouting loudly in the village since he was a child because he is the village chief. It can be said that he is a little bully among the younger generation in the village.Except for Su Xingfeng, because Su An always fought with Su Xingfeng when he was a child, but Su An just couldn't fight, and Su An accepted it after two rounds.Isn't it because Su Xingfeng is a little older than him?So I kept calling him Brother Xingfeng.

Toot…

Following the beep of this second-hand motorcycle, Su Xingfeng also headed towards Su City.

After riding for more than an hour, he finally arrived in the city. However, motorcycles are now banned in the city. Su Xingfeng had to park his motorcycle in the suburbs, lock it, and then take a bus into the city.

After many rounds, he came to a market, which was the largest market in the city. Everything was sold, and he asked where there was a place to collect snake skins.Carrying a big bag on his back, he came to a Tongrentang medicinal material store.

The store is very large, and it is a wholesale store.

“Sir, what medicinal materials do you want to purchase?"At this time, a young girl saw Su Xingfeng entering the store and walked up and asked.
